name: f4
_doc: f4: members are refits on the final store, seed counts in brackets: d <= 1 h stack c7 (6), cs7 (3), mlp7 (6), fs8 c7 (6); 1-4 h stack c6s (6), c5s (6), x5 (6, xgboost 2.1.4), c7 (6), fs8 c7 (6). Segment weights: NNLS on the 2025 Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul month-out predictions (research/final/pseudo_final.py fit-weights): d <= 1 h c7 0.145542, cs7 0.252147, mlp7 0.247639, fs8 c7 0.354673; 1-4 h c6s 0.297598, c5s 0.021663, x5 0.324981, c7 0.0, fs8 c7 0.355759. Rows past 4 h: long stack (c6s, c5s, x5, c7; weights from the 2025 A/B OOF) blended with the physical estimate (plog, alpha 1); rows whose AOBT_3 is more than 4 h before takeoff and LIRF rows without AOBT_3 (long.fill = long_stack) take the long stack unblended. Overlay: LIRF rows without ADS-B evidence and d <= 4 h get 0.7 pred + 0.3 k4. Cap pred <= d past 2 h. Level calibration: lam 0.75, cap 0.05, composition offset fitted on the 2025 12-month-out c6 OOF. Post layers: lv_rules with rules 'ad' (NM join window, LEMD/LEBL cap), recovered (L0e), daily (L1a; parameters research/final/levers/artifacts/daily_params.json; L1a-v2 ordinary-row loadings research/final/artifacts/daily_v2_f4_loadings.json, fitted on f4's own 2025 pseudo-final rows), recovered again. Assembler rules: NM join window +-3,631 s, LEMD/LEBL <= 3,604 s, floor 60.
notes: Level calibration: composition offset fitted on the 2025 12-month-out c6 OOF (research/cache/oof_mo12_c6.parquet), lam 0.75, cap 0.05.
Post layers: research/final/levers (lv_rules.py, recovered.py, daily.py); described in docs/METHOD.md sections 3 and 4 (Step 7).
mlp7: 6 seeds (prc-f-mlp7m6: r2912 from prc-f-mlp7a, r2911/r2913 from prc-f-mlp7c, r2914-r2916 from prc-f-mlp7b).
Segment weights fitted on the 2025 month-out predictions (four months, rows without date-shift artifacts or short-delay y > 3 h); the long stack keeps f3's A/B weights.
L1a-v2 loadings refitted on f4's frozen 2025 pseudo-final rows (col post2_recovered); the 2026 build reads only the fitted artifact.
c6s, c5s and x5: 6 seeds (prc-f-c6s + prc-f-c6sb, prc-f-c5s + prc-f-c5sb, prc-f-x5 + prc-f-x5b; research/final/merge_members.py). fs8 c7: 6 seeds (prc-f8-c7a + prc-f8-c7b).
